name: PTC India Limited
summary: PTC India Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the trading and generating power in India, Nepal, Bhutan, and Bangladesh. The company operates through two segments, Power and Financing Business. It engages in long term, medium term, and short-term power trading activities; and cross border power trading business. The company provides financing solutions to the energy value chain, including investing in equity or extending debt to power projects in generation, transmission, distribution, fuel resources, and fuel related infrastructure, as well as consultancy and advisory services.
